subject: OptiMed marketplace enrollment & AWS co-sell pairing — PDM/PSM alignment
messages:
From: Jordan Ellis <j.ellis@optimed.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 21 Sep 2026 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: AWS listing + co-sell — next steps from OptiMed

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks again for the demo last week. The team at OptiMed is excited about the latency/cost profile you showed — it maps well to a clinical decision-support workflow we're piloting. Wed like to get started with the AWS listing and co-sell pathway so we can surface Redwood in our environment and pursue a joint opportunity with our AWS account team.

High-level asks from our side:
- Steps to register OptiMed on AWS for a marketplace listing (any docs or intake forms).
- Intro to the AWS PDM/PSM so we can align on co-sell ownership and next steps.
- A short mutual action plan (MAP) that outlines timelines for listing, POC, and joint customer intro.

We can be flexible on timing. Jordan
Head of Platform Partnerships
OptiMed Health

Attachments: none
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Ellis <j.ellis@optimed.com>, Rachel Barnes <rachel.barnes@aws-partners.amazon.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 22 Sep 2026 09:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: AWS listing + co-sell — next steps from OptiMed

Jordan / Rachel / team,

Great timing — happy to kick this off. Quick summary and proposed plan:

1) ACE registration: I will share the AWS ACE registration checklist and our internal listing package draft. Rachel, can you confirm the preferred intake form (Marketplace vs ACE portal)?

2) PDM/PSM intro: If Alex Turner is the right PDM/PSM pair, please loop them in for a 30-min alignment where we assign lead ownership for co-sell motions and confirm deal routing.

3) MAP: Attached is a draft mutual action plan with milestones (ACE registration, listing asset completion, joint POC, co-sell introduction to OptiMeds target customers). Please review and add dates.

Action items for OptiMed: review the attached checklist, confirm timelines for your security questionnaire turnaround, and nominate the AWS account rep (if different from Rachel).

Ill propose slots for a 30-min PDM/PSM alignment and send a calendar invite once we confirm availability.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Senior Partner Lead, Redwood Inference

Attachments: OptiMed-AWS-Listing-Checklist.pdf, OptiMed-MAP-draft.xlsx
From: Rachel Barnes <rachel.barnes@aws-partners.amazon.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Jordan Ellis <j.ellis@optimed.com>
Cc: Alex Turner <alex.turner@aws-partners.amazon.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 23 Sep 2026 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: AWS listing + co-sell — next steps from OptiMed

Thanks Kimberly and Jordan — welcome, OptiMed!

Quick notes:
- ACE vs Marketplace: For this workflow, ACE registration is ideal because it enables the co-sell path and PDM/PSM support. I'll send the ACE intake link and the co-sell enablement checklist separately.
- PDM/PSM pairing: Alex (ccd) will be the PDM lead; I will act as the PSM liaison for co-sell coordination.
- Intake timing: ACE intake typically takes 7-10 business days for an initial eligibility check; full listing with assets is often 3-4 weeks depending on asset completeness.

Alex, can you join a 30-min alignment next Tue (28 Sep) 10:00-10:30 PT? Kimberly, Jordan — does that slot work on your side?

Rachel Barnes
Senior Partner Manager, AWS Marketplace

Attachments: link to ACE intake (sent separately)

Date: Mon, 28 Sep 2026 09:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: AWS listing + co-sell — next steps from OptiMed

All — confirmed for Tue 28 Sep 10:00-10:30 PT. Agenda for the 30-min call:
- Quick intros and roles (5 min)
- ACE intake checklist and owner assignments (10 min)
- MAP milestones and target dates (10 min)
- Immediate blockers and next steps (5 min)

Pre-work: Jordan / OptiMed please review page 2 of the attached checklist (security questionnaire items) and flag anything that will take more than two weeks to complete. Marissa: Ill own the listing asset package; Laura will own the POC logistics.

Jordan — Ill send calendar invites and include the ACE intake URL and a shared Google Drive folder with the draft assets. Looking forward to pairing on this.

Thanks,
Kimberly
Senior Partner Lead, Redwood Inference
